pages.title: Graviton Field Emitter
pages.text: A field emitter upgraded with a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens element, so it projects gravity as well as fields. It weighs more on one side than the other, and that side changes. Dust drifts toward its face and settles in slow rings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Better emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. I added a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens to a field emitter, with a hyperdimensional processor and hyperon crystal to shape the field. It projected gravity cleanly.

Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Component Tiers.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiomatic Field Emitter, Chronal Field Projector, Dimensional Lift Projector, Empirical Notes I, Graviton Field Projector, Vacuum State Projector.
